# LLMs.txt - Portfolio Configuration
# Purpose: Provide context and instructions for LLM-assisted development on this project
# Last updated: 2026-08-12
# Author: queirozz (Henrique Jorge de Queiroz)

## Project Overview
- **Name**: queirozz Portfolio
- **URL**: https://queirozz.vercel.app
- **Type**: Personal developer portfolio
- **Owner**: Henrique Jorge de Queiroz
- **Repository**: https://github.com/queirozz8/portfolio

## Technical Stack
### Core
- **Framework**: React 18.3.1
- **Language**: TypeScript 5.8.3
- **Bundler**: Vite 5.4.19
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 3.4.17 + ShadCN UI components
- **State Management**: TanStack Query (React Query) 5.83.0
- **Router**: React Router DOM 6.30.1

### UI & Animation
- **Animation**: Framer Motion 12.35.2
- **Icons**: Lucide React 0.462.0
- **Theming**: Next Themes 0.3.0 (dark mode support)
- **Components**: Radix UI primitives, Sonner (toasts), Vaul (drawers)
- **Carousel**: Embla Carousel React 8.6.0
- **Charts**: Recharts 2.15.4
- **Forms**: React Hook Form 7.61.1 + Zod 3.25.76
- **Date Picker**: React Day Picker 8.10.1 + date-fns 3.6.0
- **OTP Input**: input-otp 1.4.2
- **Resizable Panels**: react-resizable-panels 2.1.9
- **i18n**: i18next 25.8.17 + react-i18next 16.5.6

### Build & Quality
- **Package Manager**: pnpm (workspace)
- **ESLint**: 9.32.0 with React hooks and refresh plugins
- **Testing**: Vitest 3.2.4 + Playwright 1.57.0
- **PostCSS**: 8.5.6 with Autoprefixer 10.4.21
- **Tailwind Plugins**: tailwindcss-animate 1.0.7, @tailwindcss/typography 0.5.16

## Project Structure
```
portfolio/
├── public/                    # Static assets
│   ├── fonts/                 # Custom fonts (Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans)
│   ├── images/                # Project images

│   └── robots.txt            # SEO configuration
├── src/
│   ├── components/           # React components (UI + custom)
│   │   ├── Navbar.tsx        # Navigation bar
│   │   ├── Hero.tsx          # Hero section
│   │   ├── StackSection.tsx  # Technology stack showcase
│   │   ├── ExperienceSection.tsx  # Work experience
│   │   ├── ProjectsSection.tsx    # Project showcase
│   │   ├── WorkStyleSection.tsx  # Work methodology
│   │   ├── Footer.tsx        # Site footer
│   │   └── ui/               # ShadCN UI components
│   ├── pages/                # Page components
│   │   ├── Index.tsx         # Main portfolio page
│   │   └── NotFound.tsx      # 404 page
│   ├── hooks/                # Custom React hooks
│   ├── i18n/                 # Internationalization
│   ├── assets/               # Additional assets
│   ├── App.tsx               # Root component
│   ├── main.tsx              # Entry point
│   └── index.css             # Global styles
├── AGENTS.md                 # AI agent instructions
├── package.json
└── README.md
```

## Development Guidelines

### Code Style
- Use TypeScript with strict typing
- Follow ShadCN UI component patterns
- Use tailwind-merge for class merging
- Use clsx for conditional classes
- Use class-variance-authority for variant handling
- Prefer functional components with hooks

### Component Creation
1. Check existing components in `/src/components/ui/` before creating new ones
2. Use Radix UI primitives for accessibility
3. Add proper TypeScript interfaces/props
4. Include JSDoc comments for complex components
5. Follow the existing folder structure

### Accessibility
- All interactive elements must be keyboard navigable
- Use proper ARIA attributes
- Ensure color contrast meets WCAG standards
- Test with screen readers when possible
- Use semantic HTML elements

### Performance
- Use React.lazy for code splitting
- Implement proper memoization (useMemo, useCallback)
- Optimize images with proper sizes and formats
- Use React Query for data fetching and caching
- Avoid unnecessary re-renders

### Responsive Design
- Mobile-first approach
- Use Tailwind's responsive prefixes (sm:, md:, lg:, xl:)
- Test on multiple screen sizes
- Ensure touch targets are adequate on mobile

## Site Sections
1. **Navbar**: Navigation with smooth scrolling
2. **Hero**: Personal introduction with animated cursor
3. **Stack**: Technology stack with interactive Atlas panels
4. **Experience**: Work experience timeline
5. **Projects**: Portfolio projects showcase
6. **Work Style**: Development methodology
7. **Footer**: Contact information and links

## Custom Features
- **CustomCursor**: Animated cursor with glow effects
- **AmbientCursorGlow**: Ambient glow following cursor
- **Vesper Theme**: Dark theme with custom styling
- **Motion**: Smooth animations throughout

## Deployment
- **Platform**: Vercel
- **Domain**: queirozz.vercel.app
- **Build Command**: `pnpm build`
- **Dev Command**: `pnpm dev`
- **Preview Command**: `pnpm preview`

## Best Practices for LLMs
1. **Before coding**:
   - Read AGENTS.md in the project root
   - Read relevant documentation in /docs
   - Inspect existing components
   - Understand current implementation

2. **Changes**:
   - Prefer incremental changes
   - Preserve existing architecture
   - Avoid unnecessary dependencies
   - Reuse existing components and utilities
   - Never invent personal or professional information
   - Never expose secrets

3. **Validation**:
   - Run lint: `pnpm lint`
   - Run typecheck: `pnpm typecheck` or `tsc --noEmit`
   - Run tests: `pnpm test`
   - Run build: `pnpm build`
   - Inspect resulting UI when browser tooling available

4. **Git**:
   - Work on dedicated branches
   - Do not commit unless explicitly requested
   - Never push directly to main without approval
   - Use conventional commit messages

## Environment Variables
- None required for development (static site)
- Vercel handles deployment automatically on push to main
